records.part: VMS (Variable Message Signs) replacement at Caltrain stations
records.reason: The current VMS are no longer supported by the manufacturer.

records.part: PADS Phase 2: Modernization of passenger arrival prediction and messaging system
records.reason: The existing PADS was designed in 2012, deployed in 2014, and has reached the end of its useful life.

records.part: VHF Voice Radio Modernization - tunnel coverage and emergency services capability
records.reason: The current voice and PTC systems utilize a leaky coaxial design to provide radio coverage in Caltrain’s tunnels, which has been inadequate for train crews to communicate to dispatch

records.part: Digital customer displays with text-to-speech capabilities at multi-level station entrances
records.reason: This solution was identified at the Customer Experience Task Force to address multi-level stations where customers need to walk up or down the stairs

records.part: Station connections to Caltrain Fiber Optic Backbone
records.reason: The current station connection via lease-lines managed by SamTrans IT for systems including CCTV, VMS, PA, and Train Control poses a cybersecurity threat

records.part: Rail Operations Real-time Database/Data Warehouse consolidating operational data streams
records.reason: Currently, numerous independent systems do not share information adequately.

records.part: Public Address (PA) system overhaul including speakers, amplifiers, and zone controllers
records.reason: The audio (speaker, amplifier, zone controller) at stations are obsolete.

records.part: Procurement of six additional BEMU trains for service to Gilroy
records.reason: This project includes the procurement of six additional BEMU trains to provide additional service to Gilroy before the electrification of this part of the corridor, which is part of the HSR project.

records.part: Digital customer displays with text-to-speech capabilities at South Santa Clara County stations
records.reason: This will provide up-to-date train service information to customers using these stations, which currently do not have VMS.

records.part: Broadband wireless communications system for wayside train maintenance diagnostics and passenger Wi-Fi
records.reason: The program will investigate leveraging the existing infrastructure such as OCS poles and the JPB fiber network to communicate with passing trains.

records.part: Migration to digital voice radio system replacing obsolete crew radio equipment
records.reason: This program is part of the continual effort to migrate toward a digital voice radio system to replace existing obsolete equipment for crews working in the operating right-of-way or onboard trains.

records.part: Broadband Wireless Communications System Enhancements for onboard operational systems data transfer
records.reason: This expansion will be integrated with the EMU train systems to provide real-time information from the train to the control center and allow real-time monitoring of the EMUs, CCTV, and data collection systems

records.part: Overhead Contact System (OCS)/Catenary system improvements including monitoring system
records.reason: The Catenary System is a critical component of the Caltrain electrification system, providing electrical power to trains.

records.part: New private wireless network as backup to Caltrain's fiber optic architecture
records.reason: This backup system will reduce or eliminate the need for ongoing leasing costs of a third-party fiber backup and provide more autonomy to Caltrain.

records.part: OCS and signaling for the San Mateo Parking Track
records.reason: This project will enable the design and construction of the OCS and signaling for the San Mateo Parking Track, which is being replaced as part of the 25th Avenue Grade Separation project, and tie into the main OCS.

records.part: Cellular-based broadband wireless communications system on diesel trains
records.reason: This project will implement a cellular-based broadband wireless system on diesel trains, enabling better passenger Wi-Fi services while onboard.
